Short title and commencement

MOTION PICTURES (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
MOTION PICTURES
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE CVIII OF
2002
(An Ordinance
further to amend the Motion Pictures Ordinance, 1979)
[Gazette of Pakistan
Extraordinary Part-I, 30th October, 2002]
F. No. 2(1)/2002-Pub., dated
30-10-2002.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is
hereby published for general information:---
1. Short title and commencement. ---(1) This Ordinance may
be called the Motion Pictures (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into-force at
once.

Amendment of section 8, Ordinance XLIII of 1979

MOTION PICTURES (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
MOTION PICTURES
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE CVIII OF
2002
(An Ordinance
further to amend the Motion Pictures Ordinance, 1979)
[Gazette of Pakistan
Extraordinary Part-I, 30th October, 2002]
F. No. 2(1)/2002-Pub., dated
30-10-2002.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is
hereby published for general information:---
2. Amendment of section 8,
Ordinance XLIII of 1979.---In the Motion Pictures Ordinance, 1979 (XLIII of
1979), in section 8,---
(a) in
subsection (2), for the words "District Magistrate" the words
"Zila Nazim" shall be substituted; and
(b) In
subsection (5), for the words "District Magistrate" the words
"Zila Nazim" shall be substituted.
